records.name: Roberto Martinez Foundation
records.summary: A nonprofit that gives scholarships, grants and help with basic needs to people on low to moderate incomes around Philadelphia. It also runs yearly golf, gala and party fundraisers, and volunteers help with those events and with community outreach.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer at the yearly events or with community outreach, or buy tickets to the golf, gala and party events.

schedule.text: Yearly golf, gala and party events. Blue and Gold Week is listed for June 18 to July 1, 2027. The site does not give dates for the other events.

locations.label: Registered office (from the IRS record, not shown on the group's site)

cost.text: Tickets are sold for the yearly events. The page text I read did not show prices.

first_step.how: Use the contact form on rmfnd.com and choose 'Be a volunteer' to ask about the next event
first_step.basis: Volunteering and public event tickets both have a clear way in, but the site does not say what a new volunteer does first.

records.notes: Founded in 2025 according to the site, with no month given. The email address is hidden behind email protection on the page, so only the phone is recorded. The site calls it a registered 501(c)(3) with a volunteer option and a board that meets quarterly. Status is probably_active because the site is live with a 2027 event and no month-dated items. It is a public charity with events and volunteers, so it is listed here rather than hidden as a private foundation. Owner may want to review.

records.name: Sinoe County Association in the Americas
records.notes: The website on the IRS record (www.scaainc.net) did not resolve on two tries, with and without www, so it is treated as missing. No search was left to find a new site. The IRS record lists a P.O. Box in 19114. The group's activity was not checked, so no summary is written. Held back until someone checks by hand.

records.name: Socks for the Streets
records.summary: Gives socks and other basic supplies to people facing homelessness or addiction, and helps connect them to other services. Most people take part by donating, and sock drives are how the group began.
records.what_you_do: Donate socks or money, or submit the contact form to learn about volunteer opportunities.

first_step.how: Submit the form on the Contact Us page of socksforthestreets.org to learn about volunteer opportunities, or donate socks or money through the Donate button
first_step.basis: The site asks people to submit its form to learn about volunteer opportunities, which is an open way in.

records.notes: Founded in 2019 according to the site. The dated items are history only (a 2021 total of socks collected and a 2022 board), and there are no dated events or news. Status is probably_active from the working site with live donation and volunteer forms, not from dated activity. The site says the group provides Community Service Hours but does not say it issues service-hours letters, so service_hours_letter stays unknown.

records.name: Son of God Outreach Ministries
records.notes: The website on the IRS record (WWW.SGODOM.ORG) refused connections on two tries. That looks like the site being down rather than a bot check, so it is listed under blocked. No search was left. The IRS address is 2810 Saxton Rd Apt a, 19114. The group's activity was not read, so no summary is written.

records.name: STEM Academy

Both searches went to other groups in this batch, so this one was not checked. The IRS address is 12038 Alberta Dr, 19154. Needs a manual look before any summary is written.

records.name: A Seat at the Table Foundation
records.notes: The site returned a page with no text on two tries, so nothing could be read. A browser check may be needed. No search was left. The IRS address is 1222 N 27th St, 19121.

records.name: Alice Harris Foundation
records.notes: Scholarship and career education foundation for students in hospitality, travel and tourism, established in 2019 according to the site. The only ways in on the site are donation, a contact form and a newsletter. No volunteer, membership, class or event route is shown. Hidden as private for owner review. Could be reconsidered if a student program with public sessions turns up. Published contacts, for reference: aliceharrisfoundation@gmail.com and 1-844-711-7337.

records.name: Alliance of Black Social Workers
records.summary: The Philadelphia chapter of a national group of Black social workers. It offers professional development and advocacy, plus a place to build strategies for community well-being. Members include social welfare professionals and people from other fields.
records.what_you_do: Join as a member through the membership page, go to chapter meetings and conferences, or reach out through the Connect with Us form to ask about volunteering.

first_step.how: Apply for membership through the Join button on the chapter site, or use the Connect with Us form to ask about volunteering
first_step.basis: Joining means an application through the site, and the page does not say what members get before they apply.

records.notes: The newest dated items are 2024 chapter conference materials. The page gives no month, so status is unknown rather than guessed. The 2019 footer year is not evidence. Mailing address: P.O. Box 42347, Philadelphia, PA 19101. The site publishes ZIP 19101 for the street address, while the IRS record has 19121. Membership runs through an online portal with applications and renewals.

records.name: Friends of Bodine
records.summary: A friends group that hosts community socials and keeps people posted through a mailing list. Its listed 2026 fall social is at a Philadelphia brewery, and people RSVP through a form on the site.
records.what_you_do: Come to the socials, RSVP through the site, or sign up for the mailing list to hear about the next event.

schedule.text: 2026 fall social at Philadelphia Brewing Company. The site does not give the day or month.

first_step.how: RSVP for the 2026 fall social with the RSVP form on friendsofbodine.org, and sign up for the mailing list there
first_step.basis: Events are posted publicly with an RSVP form and a mailing list sign-up, but the site does not say whether events are members only.

records.notes: The only event on the site is a 2026 fall social with no day or month, so last_sign_of_life is left out. The site does not describe the group's wider work, so the summary covers only what it lists. The footer shows 2024, which is not evidence. Philadelphia Brewing Company is the event venue, and the group's own address is not shown. Category and kind are a best fit.

records.name: Grief Retreat
records.notes: The website field on the IRS record holds an address, not a web address. The one search for this group found only a third-party tax data profile (https://causeiq.com/organizations/grief-retreat,922684089). That profile describes a Philadelphia mental health treatment center with a late 2023 filing. No website, program or public contact was found, so it is hidden as private. Re-check if a public site, program or contact appears. The profile was last updated in April 2024 and may be stale.

records.name: Mara-Fiki
records.notes: The group's work described on the site is a textile workshop and artist internship in Wote, Kenya, with donations for supplies. The contact page lists a Philadelphia street address (1400 North American Street, 19122, the same as the IRS record) and a US phone number, but no Philadelphia program was found. Verdict is out_of_area. Revisit if a Philadelphia program or volunteer route turns up.

records.name: Peacetown Commons Land Trust
records.notes: The website on the IRS record (WWW.PEACETOWNCLT.ORG) did not resolve, with or without www, on two tries, so it is treated as missing. No search was left. The IRS address is 2226 W Jefferson St, 19121. The group's activity was not checked, so no summary is written.

records.name: Philadelphia Advocates for Community Enrichment and Solidarity
records.notes: The IRS name is garbled as 'Commun Ity', and the website field holds a name, not a web address. Searches on the full name and the acronym PACES found no match. The search returned three other groups (Philly Advocates in Logan, the Philadelphia Association of Community Development Corporations, and PA Solidarity Project). None of them is this group, so they are listed as leads only. The IRS address is 1916 N Croskey St, 19121. Held back until checked by hand.

records.name: Sergio Foundation
records.summary: A charity that gathers clothing, food and toiletries and hands them out to people who are homeless or going through hard times. Volunteers help serve warm meals and pack toiletry bags.
records.what_you_do: Serve warm meals or pack toiletry bags as a volunteer, or donate items or money.

first_step.how: Fill in the Get involved form on the Contact Us page of sergiofoundation.com to ask about volunteering
first_step.basis: The site invites people to reach out about volunteering through a public form, and it shows volunteers at work.

records.notes: The Events section says to check back and lists nothing. The footer year 2026 is not evidence, so status is probably_active from the working site alone. The IRS address (1911 N Mascher St, 19122) is not shown on the group's site, so it is not recorded as a location.

records.name: Society of Spanish and Spanish-American Studies
records.notes: The website on the IRS record points to a Temple University page (WWW.TEMPLE.EDU/SPANPOR) that returns 404, so it is treated as missing. The IRS name is cut off as 'Incorpora'. The name suggests a scholarly society, but nothing about its meetings, membership or location was confirmed. No search was left. The IRS address is Temple University, Anderson Hall 4th floor, 19122. Held back until checked by hand.

leads_only.note: Appeared in search results for the Philadelphia Advocates name. Described there as an information and referral group in the Logan neighborhood. Not checked, and not the same as the IRS group.

leads_only.name: Philadelphia Association of Community Development Corporations
leads_only.note: Appeared in search results as a membership group of community development corporations. Not checked.

notes: Both WebSearch calls were spent. One went to Grief Retreat and one to the Philadelphia Advocates name, and neither gave a usable match for the IRS record. Seven records are unknown with no summary and are held back: STEM Academy, Sinoe County Association, Peacetown Commons Land Trust, Society of Spanish and Spanish-American Studies, Philadelphia Advocates for Community Enrichment and Solidarity, Son of God Outreach Ministries, and A Seat at the Table Foundation. Two of these had dead domains and two had no readable page; the rest had no web address. Hidden: Alice Harris Foundation (scholarship and donation only, flagged for owner review) and Grief Retreat (no public way in found). Out of area: Mara-Fiki (workshop in Kenya; Philadelphia address on file only). Published with status probably_active on working sites with no dated activity: Roberto Martinez Foundation, Socks for the Streets, Sergio Foundation. Friends of Bodine is active on a 2026 event. Alliance of Black Social Workers has status unknown because its newest items are 2024 with no month. Service-hours letters and court-ordered status were not inferred for any group. Budget: 2 of 2 searches, 22 fetches.
